text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday was so close! Just a tiny bit 
more, and I could've passed the girl ahead 
of me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, decided! Today I'm gonna do 
some reee-search on how to get faster!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Boing-boiiing!! McQueen!! Let's do some 
kangaroo sumo wrestling!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kangaroos are faster than Umamusume!!! 
Pretty amazing, right?! So let's wrestle!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As is always the case, I don't understand 
what you mean at all~~~!

"At that moment! A flash of lightning 
struck Haru Urara's mind!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!!!! If I copy a kangaroo, wouldn't I 
be able to run super fast!?

And a vivid image of a kangaroo suddenly 
welled up inside me!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, I got it all now!! From this 
moment on, I am a kangaroooo!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I feel like I've gotten faster! Not 
that I really know for sure!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha! Running is soooo much fuuun!!!

Experiencing the speed of a kangaroo 
seemed to spark a fun new discovery within 
Haru Urara herself.
